hi: जन्मदिन की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएँ! आपका आने वाला वर्ष खुशियों और सफलता से भरा रहे। 🎂✨

en: Happy Birthday! Wishing you a year filled with happiness, good health and success. 🎂✨
Many happy returns of the day! May your new year of life be wonderful. ❤️

Janamdin ki bahut-bahut wishes! Hamesha smile karte raho aur khush raho. ❤️

Warm wishes on your anniversary. May your journey together stay beautiful. 🌹
